task.prompt:
Generate a complete sparse softmax decode-row system from signed Q/K/V to result AND selected mask under the exact supplied algorithm contract. Optimize the latency-energy-efficiency Pareto frontier subject to quality, area and 300 MHz timing constraints. Read and assign relevant immutable hardware AND golden test references. Compiler chooses modules, scheduling, numeric widths and pipeline depths; UArch generates each implementation, then a separate assembly implements the full system. Prefer compatible native library reuse with linked_reference_ids and thin generated adapters; inspect integrated bundles if useful. Reuse must preserve exact contract math. Start from a correct compact implementation; one-query-per-cycle throughput is not required. All algorithm parameters are chosen by Kernel from measured profiles and can be revisited by Critic. No manually supplied system plan or previous generated RTL. The expanded catalog contains official Sanger mask/packing/sparse-PE references, FLOW/FlexCiM N:M operand distribution, SpAtten real TopK/QuickSelect and a signed bitonic network. In the library-reading phase inspect the relevant domain references and associated tests, then select compatible pieces or translate their design into fresh modules. Respect compatibility metadata; never use TopKDummy, approximate arithmetic in place of the exact LUT, or native-link reference-only code. This experiment requests five design rounds, not early stopping after the first feasible point.
This is a separately recorded, externally diagnosed assembly repair. The previous accepted implementation and system plan are supplied intentionally. Preserve the algorithm contract, configuration and accepted child interfaces.
